video:video.video:title: The Smart Way to Buy a New Car Without Going Broke
video:video.video:description: A longer car loan looks like the smart way to buy a new car: same car, smaller payments. But track every payment, and that "breathing room" costs about $3,500, before the expensive part even starts.

video:video.video:title: If You're Building a Business in Your 20s, Watch This
video:video.video:description: Starting a business in your 20s can feel like a race you're already losing. But the fastest-growing new companies in America, the top one in a thousand, are started by founders who are 45 on average.

video:video.video:title: Why $100K Earners Still Live Paycheck to Paycheck
video:video.video:description: Most people think living paycheck to paycheck is an income problem, so they chase a bigger salary. But nearly half of Americans earning over $100K still live that way, because the number that matters was never your salary.

video:video.video:title: When to Sell Stocks Never Answer With a Price
video:video.video:description: Knowing when to sell stocks seems simple: pick a price and wait for it. Yet bitcoin ETFs made 8.5% a year, while the average dollar people put in them lost almost 6% a year.

video:video.video:title: Too Many Interests That’s Where the Money Is
video:video.video:description: If you have too many interests, everyone says pick one: one skill, 10,000 hours, no side projects. But the money shows up when two of your interests touch.
